outstanding_asks.ask: (Outdated thread) Preserve the auto-generated React `ref` when rendering a `DataTable` with an explicit `id` and a caller-supplied props dictionary.
Regenerate and commit `pyi_hashes.json` after adding the `copy_with` component API.
Preserve `field_dependencies` and `app_wraps` when rebuilding `VarData` for styled Bare components.
Make `_literalize_static_ids` rebuild and literalize components embedded in `Var` metadata so prop-held head components do not retain `useRef` hooks.
Recompute DataEditor `get_cell_content` when `copy_with()` replaces columns or data, or make hook generation consistently use the stored callback.
Use `self.contents._get_all_var_data()` during Bare styling so components present only in merged Var metadata are traversed.
Fix the compiled-output test to match JSX attribute syntax such as `getCellContent={...}` instead of the nonexistent colon form.
Remove padding from the copied root style before adding the textarea-specific rule so the immutability refactor does not apply padding twice.
Pass derived DataTable props directly to `_render` so concrete dataframes are not fully serialized twice.
Raise a clear `ValueError` listing accepted icon-button sizes instead of leaking a `KeyError` for unsupported strings.
Run `uv run python scripts/make_pyi.py` and update the generated-stub hash manifest for the new component API.
Strengthen the static-id literalization test to assert refs, because `_get_all_hooks()` does not traverse components stored in props.
Capture the component returned by `_add_style_recursive` for `hydrate_fallback` so the styled immutable copy is not discarded.
Exercise compiler hook deduplication in the two-editor test, or rename/reword the test so it does not claim behavior it never checks.
Wrap `handle_submit_unique_name` with `LiteralVar.create(...)` in `copy_with` so the `Var[str]` field does not become a raw string.
Replace the internal package development pin with a published `reflex-base` floor, or add release-time repinning before the internal auto-release gate.
